comparison.objective: Pipe a continuous shell border on a cake; candidate finishes four metal inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate nozzle pose, contact height, motion, and continuous squeeze pressure to form repeated icing shells versus impact tooling and rigid-fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Border follows the required path with acceptable shell continuity/placement and without damaging the cake; no fracture or debris rubric.
comparison.reason: Tests continuous deposition and synchronized force-motion control, not rigid-body notch fracture.
